name: ModelVariant102_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant102_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a dome of shaded quads grows ring by ring over the active slot, then its 96 petals launch one ring at a time towards scattered targets around the other slot, each arrived petal glows briefly, and a centre flash and a burst of 48 sparks follow); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the mesh, the petal targets and the spark offsets and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the petal flight ends, 4 while the petals arrive, 1 once after that and 2 later; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-119 and 249 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
